newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall on new crop arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall on new crop arrivals.

text.p: Cotton prices eased on Thursday on higher offerings by stockists and state-owned agencies, dealers said.
They said mill demand was poor and sentiment subdued on news of rising new crop arrivals at producing centres.

In the spot deals Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell to 13,200/13,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) from 13,700/13,800. Bengal-deshi ready delivery was available at 825/830 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while October delivery was quoted at 860/865.
